name: Nestpair
description: A ring with a disc inside it, the disc just wide enough to touch the bore.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 30% 48%, transparent 48%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 30% 48%, transparent 48%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 31%, transparent 31%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 31%, transparent 31%); opacity: 0.88; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
